not_found: term_life beyond Essential term life cover and ePROTECT mortgage
standalone rider pages (riders are described on base product pages)
notes: Entry age ranges are not shown on the product pages or brochures retrieved, so no entry ages are recorded; Etiqa states age means age at next birthday.
Left out for lack of any product content on the page or PDFs: Tiq Invest, Tiq CashSaver, Tiq Personal Accident (pages are template shells) and Esteem eternity II (Premier Solutions).

Left out: ePROTECT family (free personal accident initiative with Maybank), Corporate Employee Scheme (employee benefit), Personal Cyber Insurance, Valuables & Collections Insurance, and general insurance lines (travel, motor, home, HDB fire, maid, pet).

DIRECT - Etiqa term life II and DIRECT - Etiqa whole life have no standalone page: they are named in the FAQ of the Life & Critical Illness Protection page and bought through the online quotation portal, which robots.txt disallows for scrapers. The DPI Fact Sheet PDF is generic.
The FAQ also mentions an ePROTECT term life policy with coverage up to S$2 million but no page or PDF for it was found, so it is not listed.
Policy wording PDFs for general insurance on /policy-wordings/ were not used.
Etiqa is the Singapore arm of Maybank Group; some pages show scheduled maintenance banners for 17-18 October.
Channel is marked mixed because each page offers both Get Advice and Buy Online.
